placeholders.content: Used to differentiate ads (e.g., button vs. banner)

help.source: Identifies where your traffic is coming from, such as a search engine, newsletter, or other referral source.
help.medium: Identifies the marketing medium, such as email, CPC (cost-per-click), social media, or organic search.
help.campaign: Identifies a specific product promotion or strategic campaign to track performance.
help.term: Identifies paid search keywords. Used for paid search campaigns to track which keywords are driving traffic.
help.content: Used to differentiate similar content or links within the same ad to identify which version performs better.
